corpus: Microsoft Annual Report to Shareholders, FY2020-FY2025 (6 documents)
matching_note: recall@k is computed by checking whether any retrieved chunk contains any gold span (whitespace/case-normalized). Spans are verbatim from the source documents, so they survive re-chunking and stay comparable across fixed / structure-aware / semantic strategies.
corpus_caveat: These are Annual Reports to Shareholders, not full Form 10-Ks. They contain the shareholder letter, BUSINESS, MD&A, financial statements and notes, but they do NOT contain an Item 1A Risk Factors section - they only cross-reference it. Do not write answerable questions about risk factors.

questions.question: How much revenue did Microsoft Copilot generate in fiscal year 2025?
questions.gold_answer: REFUSE. Microsoft discusses Copilot extensively but never discloses Copilot-specific revenue; it is not a reported line item.
questions.notes: Verified: no Copilot revenue figure anywhere in the corpus. Strong distractors exist - Copilot is mentioned throughout FY2023-FY2025, and a FY2024 table row reads 'Revenue from Office Consumer products and cloud services, including Microsoft 365 Consumer and Copilot Pro subscriptions', which a naive system may misread as a Copilot revenue figure. Tests refusal despite strong retrieval - the hardest refusal case in the set.
